blocks.text: Meet the Samsung Galaxy A26 5G for Tracfone—a smartphone that combines premium features with incredible value. Built for the speed of 5G, this device is your perfect partner for streaming, sharing, and gaming on Tracfone's nationwide network. See Everything in Vivid Detail Your content comes to life on the expansive 6.7-inch FHD+ Super AMOLED display. With a 120Hz refresh rate, every scroll is silky smooth, and every scene is vibrant. Plus, with Vision Booster, you can enjoy clear viewing even in bright daylight. Capture Your World Like a Pro The advanced triple-camera system is ready for any moment. The 50MP high-resolution main camera includes Optical Image Stabilization (OIS) to eliminate blur from shaky hands, day or night. From breathtaking landscapes with the 8MP ultrawide lens to flawless selfies with the 13MP front camera, your photos have never looked better. Power That Lasts Stay connected without compromise. The massive 5,000mAh battery is built to last, giving you the power you need to browse, text, and stream all day. When it’s time to recharge, 25W Super Fast Charging gets you back in the game quickly. This device is locked to Tracfone and requires a Tracfone service plan for activation. With 128GB of built-in storage (expandable to 2TB) and an IP67 water-resistant rating, the Galaxy A26 5G is the awesome, all-around device you've been waiting for.

items.label: Carrier
items.value: This phone is locked to Tracfone, which means this device can only be used on the Tracfone Wireless network. A Tracfone plan is required to activate this device. Activating is easy, upon receipt go to the Tracfone Website and select “Activate” and follow the prompts.

items.label: Immersive 120Hz Display
items.value: Watch, browse, and game on a stunning 6.7-inch FHD+ Super AMOLED display. The 120Hz refresh rate provides an incredibly smooth, fluid scrolling experience, while Vision Booster ensures your screen stays clear and bright, even in direct sunlight.

items.label: Pro-Grade 50MP OIS Camera
items.value: Capture life in stunning detail with the 50MP main camera featuring OIS (Optical Image Stabilization) for crisp, blur-free photos and steady videos. The system also includes an 8MP ultrawide and 13MP front camera, so you get the perfect shot every time.

items.label: Massive Battery & Fast Charging
items.value: Power through your entire day and then some with a massive 5,000mAh battery. When you finally need a boost, 25W Super Fast Charging gets you back to 100% in a hurry, so you’re never tethered to an outlet for long.

items.label: Durable by Design, Ample Storage
items.value: Built to handle life's moments, the Galaxy A26 features an IP67 water and dust-resistant rating. With 128GB of internal storage and the option to add up to 2TB more with a microSD card, you'll have all the space you need for your apps, photos, and files.
